Former Queensland Police Commissioner Steve Gollschewski Dies at 67

Steve Gollschewski, the former Police Commissioner of Queensland, Australia, has died at the age of 67. Gollschewski had a distinguished career spanning over four decades in law enforcement. He led the police response to numerous significant natural disasters and the COVID-19 pandemic during his tenure. His death occurred several months after his retirement from the force.
